description: This file implements functions for on-demand harvesting of neighboring WiFi access points, including managing a linked list of data, executing system commands, and threading for periodic data collection.

methods.name: SetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the on-demand harvesting status and starts a thread if enabled.

methods.name: GetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns the current on-demand harvesting status.

methods.name: _napondemandsyscmd
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output.

methods.name: add_to_nap_ondemand_list
methods.description: Adds neighboring AP data to a linked list.

methods.name: print_nap_ondemand_list
methods.description: Prints the current list of neighboring AP data.

methods.name: delete_nap_ondemand_list
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the neighboring AP list.

methods.name: GetRadioNeighboringAPOnDemandData
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring AP data for a specific radio interface.

methods.name: StartNeighboringAPOnDemandHarvesting
methods.description: Thread function that periodically collects neighboring AP data when enabled.
